m: glāni f. (Pāṇ. iii, 3, 95, Vārtt. 4) exhaustion, fatigue of the body, lassitude, languor, depression of mind, debility, Mn. i, 53; MBh. &c.
a: glāniḥ f. [glai bhave ni] 1 Exhaustion, languor, fatigue; manaśca glānimṛcchati Ms. 1. 53; aṃgaglāniṃ suratajanitāṃ Me. 70, 31; Śānti. 4. 4. 2 Decay, decline; ātmodayaḥ paraglānirdvayaṃ nītiritīyatī Śi. 2. 30; yadā yadā hi dharmasya glānirbhavati bhārata Bg. 4. 7. 3 Debility, weakness. 4 Displeasure, unwillingness, sickness.
